author: haiku
label: seeded-07r-01
changes: No junior questions were supplied, so the rewrite is built from the first version and the brief. The file was rewritten in full, not patched.

Kept every stated fact: 6 stateless instances behind a load balancer, X-Api-Key header, Key Service resolving to customer ID and plan, 5-minute in-memory cache, forwarding and response passing, per-customer (not per-key) budgets, Standard 100/min, Enterprise left open, 401 before any counter access, 429 with Retry-After and no forwarding, no budget used by rejected requests, budget used even when the backend fails, X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining on passed requests, shared counts across instances, fail open within 50 ms with the ratelimit_store_unavailable metric, Lua check_and_incr, per-minute counters, counter TTL.
Added a 'how it works today' sentence to the summary, because the design changes the existing gateway flow.
Added a terms section for API key, customer, plan, Key Service, Redis, counter, Lua script, TTL, Retry-After, fail open and the diagram notation.
Redrew the sequence diagram to show the 401, allowed, 429 and fail-open paths. The first version showed only the happy path and omitted the 401, 429 and fail-open behavior the brief requires.

Turned the first version's bullet notes into numbered steps, and placed each design decision where it applies: a Redis Lua script for the atomic check, a fixed one-minute window with a stated burst trade-off, a 120-second counter TTL, Redis's clock for the window, Retry-After rounded up with a minimum of 1 second, and fail-open responses without X-RateLimit headers.
Merged the first version's separate notes bullets into the steps and the failure table, so each rule is stated once.
Added a failure table covering 401, 429, backend failure after the check, and Redis error or timeout, with what is recorded in each case.
Open questions: kept the Enterprise limit visibly open, and added the unstated Key Service failure case as a visible hole.
Cut: nothing from the stated facts. Repetition of the flow in the bullet notes was removed.
